_comment: Qlik Automate workflow: Cortex Agent Freshness Monitor. Import this into Qlik Automate via Management Console > Automations > Create > Import. Replace all <placeholder> values before activating.
name: Snowflake Cortex Agent — Freshness SLA Monitor
description: Calls a Snowflake Cortex Agent via REST API to check data freshness SLAs, routes alerts on breach, and writes audit records back to Snowflake.

triggers.comment: Runs every 4 hours. Adjust to match your SLA check cadence.

blocks.name: Start — Scheduled or Webhook
blocks.comment: Trigger: cron schedule (every 4h) or external webhook. To use webhook trigger instead, change triggers[0].type to 'webhook' and use the generated URL.

blocks.name: Set Configuration Variables
blocks.comment: Central config — edit these values for your environment.

blocks.name: Call Snowflake Cortex Agent REST API
blocks.comment: POST to the Cortex Agent :run endpoint. The agent returns structured JSON with freshness status for all tables.

content.text: Check freshness for {$.set_variables.target_schema} with a {$.set_variables.sla_hours}-hour SLA.

blocks.name: Parse Agent Response
blocks.comment: Extract the JSON payload from the agent response. The agent returns a JSON code block in the last message content. This block extracts key fields for downstream routing.

blocks.name: SLA Breach?
blocks.comment: Branch based on whether any tables breached their SLA.

blocks.name: Send Slack Alert
blocks.comment: Posts a breach notification to Slack. Replace with Teams webhook or email block as needed.

body.text:
:rotating_light: *Freshness SLA Breach Detected*

*Schema:* `{$.set_variables.target_schema}`
*Tables Breached:* {$.parse_response.tables_breached} of {$.parse_response.total_tables}
*SLA Threshold:* {$.set_variables.sla_hours} hours

Breached tables:
```
{$.parse_response.breaches}
```

_Triggered by Qlik Automate → Snowflake Cortex Agent_

blocks.name: Reload Qlik App (remediation)
blocks.comment: Triggers a reload of the Qlik app that feeds the stale tables. Uses the native Qlik Cloud connector. Remove this block if remediation is handled differently.

blocks.name: Write Audit Record (breach)
blocks.comment: Inserts a breach record into the Snowflake audit table using the native Snowflake connector.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO CORTEX_CODE.PUBLIC.FRESHNESS_AUDIT_LOG (schema_checked, sla_hours, total_tables, tables_ok, tables_breached, breached_tables, agent_response) SELECT '{$.set_variables.target_schema}', {$.set_variables.sla_hours}, {$.parse_response.total_tables}, {$.parse_response.tables_ok}, {$.parse_response.tables_breached}, PARSE_JSON($${$.parse_response.breaches}$$), PARSE_JSON($${$.parse_response.agent_json}$$)

blocks.name: Write Audit Record (ok)
blocks.comment: Inserts a success record into the Snowflake audit table.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO CORTEX_CODE.PUBLIC.FRESHNESS_AUDIT_LOG (schema_checked, sla_hours, total_tables, tables_ok, tables_breached, breached_tables, agent_response) SELECT '{$.set_variables.target_schema}', {$.set_variables.sla_hours}, {$.parse_response.total_tables}, {$.parse_response.tables_ok}, 0, NULL, PARSE_JSON($${$.parse_response.agent_json}$$)

connections.name: Snowflake (key-pair auth)
connections.comment: Configure in Qlik Automate: Connections > Add > Snowflake. Use key-pair authentication with an encrypted .p8 private key. See README for setup steps.
